title.narrative: Activity under preparation DigiWave grant to RSS

description.narrative: Contract related to: DigiWave grant to RSS - DRAFT --------This action will act as the operational facilitator to translate the dialogues of the EU - LAC Digital Alliance into concrete Global Gateway actions in areas not covered by other operational tools of the EU ¿ LAC Digital Alliance. It would address the following priority areas: 1) Digital governance and e-government, AI, super-computing and data protection; 2) Cybersecurity and cyber-crime; and 3) Connectivity. The programme would be implemented by a consortium of specialised MS and European bodies through a facility approach that allows for flexible adjustment to political priorities under the EU Digital Alliance.The Action would be implemented through technical assistance, capacity building, regulatory cooperation and the establishment of institutional relationships between European and Caribbean actors. This would be coordinated with and complemented by earmarked funds in the investment promotion programme also proposed under the present AAP 2025 that will directly support private sector operators in Global Gateway initiatives.The overall objective of EuroCarib DigiWave is to strengthen the EU-Caribbean Digital Alliance. It should complement existing ¿operational¿ tools to translate the political dialogues of the EU ¿ LAC Digital Alliance into concrete actions and bring the Caribbean closer to Europe, particularly to operationalise the Global Gateway dimension. To provide some concrete examples, this action could: ·complement investment in satellite connectivity by providing capacity building for ground handling and operations;·promote the uptake of European products and procedures, such as Copernicus or e-signature, that would open opportunities for European companies;·support the development of norms and regulatory frameworks, for example on cybersecurity, AI or data protection, that would then facilitate the cooperation and data exchange with European law enforcement bodies;This action will work with a broad definition, but concentrate on three main areas of intervention, primarily targeting countries that have joined the EU-LAC Digital Alliance: 1.Developing digital and e-governance systems that are in line with the human centric model of the EU. This will include regulatory and legislative reforms, including data protection rules, digital signature, eID systems, AI and its regulations, etc. It will also include services based on earth observation data from the COPERNICUS programme, particularly linked to disaster risk prevention and management as well as security. 2.Strengthening the cybersecurity and cyber crime-fighting capacities in alignment with European standards. The revision of the CARICOM Cyber Security and Cyber-crime Action Plan (CCSCAP) is supported by a team of EU LAC Digital Alliance / EL PACCTO experts. It will allow to firmly embed issues of mutual security interest for the EU and the Caribbean in the plan which should become the basis for future cooperation with a focus on operational partnerships with European stakeholders and alignment between the national laws on cyber-crime and EU/international Standards. Direct links with European stakeholders such as the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity and the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre will be established and LAC4 will be involved. Supporting Caribbean countries in developing their digital infrastructure based on secure providers of connectivity.
